kumuda.p: [Ku+muda+ṇa] (pu,na) CL=7 [Kuyaṃ pathaviyaṃ modate kumudo. Dhāna,ṭī.3va.(-688).] (Pu) (1) An elephant is named Kumuda. (2) A hell is named Kumuda. (3) A mansion is named Kumuda. (Na) (4) A lotus is named Kumuda. (5) Kumuda Saṅkhyā. (Ti)(6) One whose appearance is like a lotus.
pn: Kumuda 01. A niraya – strictly speaking, a period of suffering. It is equal to twelve Padumas. The Kokālika monk was born in Kumuda niraya. SN.i.152f; see also Snp., p.126; Snp-a.ii.476.
Kumuda 02. One of the three palaces of Sobhita Buddha in his last lay life. Bv.vii.17.
Kumuda 03. A city. There an enemy of Piyadassī Buddha, Soṇa by name, made an unsuccessful attempt to kill him by means of the elephant Doṇamukha. Bv.xiv.6; Bv-a.174.

S: kumuda：n．[〃] ① 蓮，黄蓮，白睡蓮．②クムダ地獄，大数．
